_comment: Fictional, non-graphic cases for CDS. Employee IDs match data/world.json. Confidential: visible only to parties and the mediator. Never enters the graph database.

cases.intake_text: I feel the backend tickets are not shared fairly on our squad. For the last three sprints most of the on-call and urgent fixes have landed on me while similar work gets reassigned away from a colleague. I raised it in stand-up but nothing changed. I would like a neutral review of how tickets are distributed before the next sprint planning.

Hand-offs between us on shared accounts keep slipping and we end up contacting the same client twice with different messages. I am not questioning anyone's intentions, I just think we need a clear owner per account and a short daily sync so we stop stepping on each other.

I keep getting the late evening support shifts far more often than the rest of the team, including two weekends in a row. I understand coverage is hard, but I would like the rotation reviewed so it is more even across everyone.
cases.resolution: A rotation review was run with the full Support team. Evening and weekend slots were rebalanced using a fixed rotation shared with everyone. Both parties agreed to revisit in one month.
